scope.positioning: Model parity covers goctl migration-critical behavior without requiring byte-for-byte goctl output.
scope.referenceFramework: goctl model mysql ddl, mysql datasource, pg datasource, and mongo migration compatibility

compatibilityPolicy.layout: gofly may keep generated table structs and repositories split across model and repo directories when the contract compiles and facade methods remain stable.
compatibilityPolicy.oracleDiff: goctl layout differences remain classified as model-layout-difference until the generated API contract, facade methods, cache methods, and smoke tests are equivalent for migration.
compatibilityPolicy.rootModuleHygiene: Generated-project-only dependencies stay in generated modules and must not be added to the root module.
compatibilityPolicy.offlineDatasourceFixtures: offline-datasource-fixtures cover MySQL multi-table and PostgreSQL multi-schema datasource replay without requiring live database services.
compatibilityPolicy.regeneration: Existing model facade extensions and vars.go are preserved; generated entities and repository implementations remain replaceable.
compatibilityPolicy.sqlOptions: SQL prefix selects a Redis cache namespace without changing physical table names; ignored columns remain readable and are excluded from insert/update assignments.
compatibilityPolicy.defaultMetadata: SQLColumn preserves DDL and datasource default expressions for analysis and generated-model evidence; generated Go code leaves database expressions database-owned.
compatibilityPolicy.structuredTypeOverrides: model.typeOverrides selects nullable, unsigned, then base Go types while retaining legacy model.typesMap; import paths are validated and emitted deterministically.
compatibilityPolicy.facadeMutations: go_zero SQL facade matches goctl mutation contracts: Insert returns sql.Result, while Update and Delete return error after write and cache invalidation.
compatibilityPolicy.mongoGoZeroV2: The opt-in go_zero_mongo style emits goctl-shaped constructors, ObjectID types, v2 Mongo method results, cache-aware monc calls, and create-only extension files without changing legacy driver output.
compatibilityPolicy.localTemplateExecution: SQL model --home executes a local model-entity.tpl with a fixed placeholder contract; source roots and symlinks are checked, while --remote and --branch remain accepted compatibility inputs with no remote execution.
compatibilityPolicy.primaryCacheKey: Cache-enabled go_zero SQL facades emit the goctl primary key namespace prefix: prefix:table:primary_column:value; advanced unique/list/version cache protocols remain gofly-specific.
remainingGaps: byte-for-byte advanced unique/list/version cache key format

modelSurfaces.goflySurface: gofly model mysql ddl / gofly model gen --style go_zero
gofly model pg datasource / gofly model postgresql datasource

nextPromotionCriteria: Promote model-layout-difference rows only after datasource-backed fixture replay covers MySQL and PostgreSQL without live database dependencies.
Keep Mongo parity scoped to the go_zero_mongo v2 constructor and mutation surface; byte-for-byte templates and cache-key encoding remain explicitly unclaimed.
Do not describe model support as full goctl parity unless all requiredOptions are covered by runnable tests and release gates.
Keep remote model template execution unsupported until source pinning, size limits, and a safe local replay oracle are implemented.
